source_table: Table 1, G3b, bulk damping specimen 25.3 mm thick
assumptions: Weak-loss conversion of bulk attenuation slopes to dimensionless loss factors, then average the two.
Match this average loss factor at each burst center frequency with C=alpha*M.
Effective damping acts on the whole coupled assembly, not only aluminum degrees of freedom.
This is a narrowband approximation, not a broadband viscoelastic material or mode-specific Lamb attenuation model.
Published thick 6061-T6 specimen is not a measurement of the 1 mm Wandowski plate.
No glue, support, instrument or PZT-specific loss has been measured or fitted.
